goal: Ensure orphan transactions are not stuck when a low-feerate legacy parent arrives from another peer
Preserves queued requests to fetch the missing non-witness parent from peers that announced the child
agreement: Tested ACK without substantive design rationale (Yudis-bit)
Suggests handling the mirror case where segwit reconsiderable parents are missed (Yudis-bit)
Suggests cataloging and testing all known cases together instead of a piecemeal fix (instagibbs)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it fixes an orphan relay stall when resolving non-witness parent transactions
Affects only legacy transactions, making the issue rare and reasonably deferrable
